review_comments.body:
`content_filter` loses its meaning on the Messages side.** Both the
 non-stream (`common.go:470`) and stream (`to_responses_adapter.go:548`) Messages ad
apters derive the stop reason from `status` only. `incomplete` (regardless of `incom
plete_details.reason`) becomes `max_tokens`, so a Responses upstream that stopped fo
r `content_filter` is reported to the Anthropic client as a token-limit truncation.
Now that this PR makes the gateway's own Responses output carry the distinction, con
sider reading `incomplete_details.reason` and mapping `content_filter` to a refusal-
ish stop reason (or explicitly documenting the collapse). Pre-existing mapping, but
this PR is the natural place to align the vocabulary.

- ResponseIncompleteDetails.reason enum in the spec is: max_output_tokens, max_messages, content_filter, steered (the v3.8.1 SDK documents only the first and third; steered is the WebSocket steering stop and max_messages a newer limit).
- Both Messages adapters read only status (anthropic/common.go:470, anthropic/to_responses_adapter.go:548), and responsesStatusToStopReason maps every incomplete → max_tokens.

comments.body: issue — the one untested change is the Messages adapter. case "response.completed", "response.incomplete" has no coverage: existing e2e tests send only response.completed (anthropic/e2e_test.go:460,934,1342), and common_test.go:376 covers only non-stream incomplete. Add an e2e case sending event: response.incomplete and assert stop_reason: max_tokens + usage.

note — truncated tool-call streams never get item-done events. finishToolCallItems() runs only for finish_reason == "tool_calls" (:202), yet completedResponse() still includes the partial item. Pre-existing, more visible now under incomplete.

Thanks for the review. Pushed two commits:

- `test(aigateway): cover response.incomplete in the Messages adapter stream`: an e2e case that sends `response.incomplete` through the Responses to Messages stream adapter and asserts `stop_reason: max_tokens` and the usage. It fails without the `response.incomplete` case in `handleResponsesStreamEvent` (the stream ends with `end_turn` and zero usage).
- `fix(aigateway): map a content_filter incomplete Responses reply to stop_reason refusal`: both Messages adapters now read `incomplete_details.reason`; `content_filter` becomes `refusal` and the recorder maps it back to the `content_filter` finish reason. Every other incomplete reason stays `max_tokens`. Tests cover the stream and non-stream paths. This is a separate commit, so it is easy to drop if you would rather keep the old collapse.

On the truncated tool-call streams: I left that as is. Sending `output_item.done` for a cut-off call would mark partially streamed arguments as `completed`, so it seems better decided separately.
